title: Yes Bank BYOC Rewards credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A BYOC Rewards card allowing customers to design their own rewards categories, delivering flexibility, milestone perks, and easy redemption.

eligibility: Spend ₹50,000 or more in the previous quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec), you automatically qualify for this privilege in the subsequent quarter (Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec, Jan-Mar).
